name: RVO-DTE-014 Checking Single day forces the preset selector to 'Custom'

statusDetails.message:
XFAIL RVO-DTE-014: Page does not auto-switch preset to 'Custom' when Single day is checked; preset retains its previous value (e.g. 'Today')

AssertionError: Date preset should be forced to 'Custom' in single-day mode. Got: 'Today'
assert ('custom' in 'today' or 'Today' == ''
 +  where 'today' = <built-in method lower of str object at 0x10a9e7770>()
 +    where <built-in method lower of str object at 0x10a9e7770> = 'Today'.lower
  
  + Today)
